{{nihongo|'''Anamigo Toshunushi Ōube Hyōzu Shrine'''|穴見郷戸主大生部兵主神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Tajima Province]].
